en.title: Arnav Mukhopadhyay · Near-field wireless research
en.description: Arnav Mukhopadhyay is a Ph.D. researcher at National Sun Yat-sen University, Taiwan. Explore peer-reviewed work on 6G near-field networks, pinching antennas, secure communications, and optimization.
en.name: Arnav Mukhopadhyay
en.intro: I study how the physics of wireless propagation can shape more efficient and secure 6G networks. My work brings together antenna design, beamforming, and resource optimization.
en.researchIntro: From reconfigurable apertures to energy-aware links, I connect physical channel models with practical optimization methods.

research.title: Reconfigurable antennas
research.text: Joint antenna-position and beam design for pinching-antenna systems, with a focus on multi-waveguide multicast, sustainable networks, and covert communication.

research.title: Secure, energy-aware networks
research.text: Physical-layer security for non-orthogonal multiple access and extremely large-scale arrays, combining confidential communication with wireless energy harvesting.

research.title: Intelligent wireless surfaces
research.text: Resource allocation for reconfigurable and stacked intelligent surfaces, balancing power, phase, position, reliability, and short-packet delay.

en.pubIntro: Peer-reviewed publications across wireless communications and microwave photonics. Each work is listed once, with a link to its published record.
en.pubNote: Publication totals include journal, survey, magazine, conference, and proceedings-chapter contributions. Earlier preprints of published work are not counted again.

education.title: Ph.D. in Communication Engineering
education.text: Institute of Communication Engineering. Expected March 2027. GPA 4.07/4.30 across 29 credits. Research on resource allocation and optimization for self-resilient 6G radiative near-field networks.

education.title: M.Tech. in Radio Physics and Electronics
education.text: Specialization in nanoelectronics and photonics. Score: 80.10%. GATE-2016 fellowship. Thesis on intensity- and polarization-modulation-based photonic transceiver design.

education.title: Post-B.Sc. B.Tech. in Radio Physics and Electronics
education.text: Score: 80.60%. Thesis on Automatic Dependent Surveillance–Broadcast using software-defined radio.

experience.text: Research in PASS-enabled and RIS/SIM-assisted near-field 6G systems, secure communications, simultaneous wireless information and power transfer, and resource optimization.

zh-TW.title: 安納夫 · 近場無線通訊研究
zh-TW.description: 安納夫現為臺灣國立中山大學通訊工程博士班研究生，研究領域涵蓋第六代近場無線網路、夾持式天線、安全通訊與最佳化。本站收錄經同儕審查的研究著作、學經歷與學術服務。
zh-TW.name: 安納夫
zh-TW.role: 博士班研究生・研究助理
zh-TW.heroLine: 探索近場無線通訊，開拓未來連結。
zh-TW.intro: 我研究如何運用無線傳播的物理特性，建構更節能、更安全的第六代行動通訊網路。研究結合天線設計、波束成形與資源最佳化，探索新一代無線系統的可能性。
zh-TW.expected: 博士班在學・預計 2027 年 3 月畢業
zh-TW.researchTitle: 開拓無線通訊的新境界。
zh-TW.researchIntro: 從可重構天線孔徑到兼顧能源效率的通訊鏈路，我將物理通道模型與實用的最佳化方法相結合。

research.title: 可重構天線系統
research.text: 針對夾持式天線系統進行天線位置與波束聯合設計，聚焦多波導多播、永續網路與隱蔽通訊。

research.title: 安全且節能的無線網路
research.text: 研究非正交多重存取與超大規模天線陣列的實體層安全，整合機密資訊傳輸與無線能量擷取。

research.tag: 可重構智慧反射面／堆疊式智慧超表面
research.title: 智慧無線表面
research.text: 針對可重構智慧反射面與堆疊式智慧超表面設計資源配置方法，兼顧功率、相位、位置、可靠度及短封包延遲。

zh-TW.pubTitle: 讓研究構想化為學術成果。
zh-TW.pubIntro: 收錄無線通訊與微波光子學領域經同儕審查的研究著作。每項著作僅列一次，並附正式出版紀錄連結。
zh-TW.pubVerified: 出版紀錄核對日期：2026 年 9 月 22 日
zh-TW.pubNote: 著作總數包含期刊論文、綜述、學術雜誌文章、研討會論文及會議論文集章節。已正式出版的研究，其早期預印本不另行計入。
